statement_summary: Documented security program (POL-01, HSP-01, P01, P02)
Owner designated security officer and HSP-01 senior management official
Annual SP 800-30 risk assessment, also the information part of the HSP-01 assessment
Risk decision rules; diversion risks always treated
Annual evaluation with outside review every second year
Annual policy review
Written, time-limited exceptions; none for bulk hydrogen peroxide verification
Vendor list with data held, MFA, and review date
Annual review of the email suite provider's SOC 2 report
New product: HMT check and ERI provider confirmation before first shipment
Owner-started, watched remote support; no unattended access
Own accounts; no shared credentials; no family use of the laptop
MFA on every service that offers it; app-based for email
Unique 14-character passphrases in a password manager
Standard account for daily laptop work
Phone carrier PIN; sealed recovery codes with the attorney
Monthly review of email sign-ins, forwarding rules, and bank payees
Quarterly accounting user review
Three-level classification
BOLs only from the product description sheet
Full-disk encryption on every device
Monthly backup outside the suite; quarterly restore test
Retention schedule (BOLs 2 years; registration 3 years; training records; driver data 90 days)
Deletion, shredding, and device wipe with a record
No collection of full driver license numbers
Automatic updates and antivirus stay on
Separate work network with non-default router password
AI tools only after P10 assessment; no Restricted data; no AI-drafted hazmat descriptions
HMR training every 3 years, in-depth HSP-01 training, yearly social engineering module
Incident runbook with printed contacts
Same-day incident and suspicious-order log
Report suspicious hydrogen peroxide orders to the producer and local law enforcement
Meet notification deadlines in the P08 matrix
No ransom without counsel and an OFAC check
Supplier hold-release instruction when the owner cannot be reached
Reciprocal coverage arrangement with another distributor
Transportation security risk assessment
Personnel security check before any hire with release authority
Single-use pickup number via portal or phone; call-back on changes
MFA and monthly review on accounts that carry pickup authorizations
Know-your-customer checks for hydrogen peroxide
Approved bulk carriers; direct delivery; delivery confirmation; overdue escalation
Security awareness and in-depth security training plan
Written plan, annual review, notice of revisions, copy available to DOT or DHS
